title: How a Life Insurance Policy Works

cues.text: What happens to the money you pay into life insurance year after year?
That is a life insurance policy at work, turning small regular contributions into a secure family safety net.
See Dev paying his monthly premium?
Every month, Dev pays a regular fee called a premium to his insurance provider to keep his coverage active.
Now look at the large shared pool on the right.
The company collects these payments from thousands of people, gathering them into one large shared pool of money.
See the arrow leaving the pool?
When a policyholder passes away, a valid claim triggers a payout from that shared accumulation.
Now look at the family receiving the funds.
The company disburses a large tax-free lump sum known as a death benefit to support the beneficiaries financially.
life insurance transforms steady contributions into a guaranteed financial cushion. You can now spot how shared risk protects families everywhere.
